topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The bank statement shows a balance of Rs.4,000. A cheque of Rs. 1,000, drawn in favour of a creditor has not yet been presented for payment.  Calculate the bank balance after the creditor presents the cheque for payment.
e: Correct answer: Rs.3,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Omission of paise and showing the round figures in financial  statements is based on which of the following concepts?
e: Correct answer: Materiality concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Shipra Ltd is a non-life insurance company. It is required to comply with which of the following act/s while preparing its financial statements?

I. The Insurance Amendment Act 2015
II. The Companies Act 2013
III. Insurance Regulatory Development Act, 1999
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per AS 14 Accounting for amalgamations, purchase consideration is what is payable to:
e: Correct answer: shareholders of the transferor company (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A wrong entry on the debit side of cash book would lead to_________.
e: Correct answer: Cash book showing more balance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Identify the correct full form of AICPA.
o: American Institute of Certified Professional Accou
American Institute of Certified Public Accountants
American Institute of Company Public Accountants
American Institute of Chartered Public Accountants
American Institute of Certified Public Actuarial
e: Correct answer: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An accounting student says that all transactions are events but all events are not transactions. Is he right? Debate. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: All events are transactions and all therefore all
All events cannot be transactions because an event should be measurable in terms of money to be categorised as a transaction
e: Correct answer: All events cannot be transactions because an event should be measurable in terms of money to be categorised as a transaction (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A company wants to assess the ability of the company to generate cash and cash equivalent, and the needs of the company to utilise those cash flows. Suggest a financial tool.
e: Correct answer: Cash Flow Statement (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following items would not be covered by IFRS 4 Insurance Contracts?

I. Life insurance
II. Marine insurance
III. Pension plan
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In the case of an insurance company, if the company does not disclose any matters which are not required to be disclosed by the Insurance Act, 1938, still the financial statements of the company shall be treated as not disclosing a true and fair view of the state of affairs of the company. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: As per section 129 of the Companies Act, 2013 if an insurance company does not disclose any matters which are not required to be disclosed by the Insurance Act, 1938, the financial statements of the company shall not be treated as not disclosing a true and fair view of the state of affairs
If an insurance Company does not disclose any matt
e: Correct answer: As per section 129 of the Companies Act, 2013 if an insurance company does not disclose any matters which are not required to be disclosed by the Insurance Act, 1938, the financial statements of the company shall not be treated as not disclosing a true and fair view of the state of affairs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The premium paid at the time of acquisition of Govt. Securities, Debt Securities and Redeemable Preference Shares is amortised over how many years?

I. Residual period of maturity
II. Actual Period of maturity
III. Written-off in the first year
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per the Companies Act, 1956 which of the following is not one of the characteristics of a public limited company?

I. Has more than fifty members
II. Has a minimum paid-up capital of one lakh rupees
III. The shares of the company are freely transferable
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Valuation of stock in accounting follows the principle of cost price or __________ whichever is lower.
e: Correct answer: Net realisable value (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following are termed as financial statements?

I. Balance sheet
II. Profit or loss
III. Notes to accounts
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Trial Balance is prepared to check accuracy of ________________.
e: Correct answer: Ledger Accounts Balances (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Indian companies may apply the newly notified Ind-AS for in FY.______ voluntarily but from __________ applications of Ind-AS is mandatorily for all Indian companies as directed by MCA
e: Correct answer: 2015 - 16; 2016 - 17 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
In accordance with regulatory directives issued to general insurance companies, all investments in assets or instruments made by such companies have to comply with certain requirements. Which one of the following statement applies to such companies?

I. Investments in equity shares listed on a registered stock exchange should be made in actively traded and liquid instruments
II. Investments shall not be made in instruments, which are not rated
III. The rating should be carried out by a credit rating agency registered under SEBI
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe an informal accounting statement that lists the ledger account balances at a point in time and compares the total of debit balances with the total of credit balances.
e: Correct answer: Trial Balance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per the Companies Act, a Directors report should disclose comparative information with regards to which of the following?

I. Gross Direct Premium and percentage of growth over previous year
II. Reinsurance Premium Ceded
III. Reinsurance Accepted
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following documents, data and particulars are generally contained in the annual report of a general insurance company?

I. Share Capital and Increase in Paid-up Capital, if any.
II. Dividend Approved and Declaration
III. Business review and summary of operations
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The matching concept matches which of the following?
e: Correct answer: Revenues with expenses (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Devise a solution for a company if it has surplus share capital as well as bank balance and it desires to balance both.
e: Correct answer: Buy-back of shares (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Accounting concepts?
o: Accounting concept refers to the basic assumptions
These concepts are assumed and accepted in account
Every company can follow their own accounting concepts as per their convenience
The accounting concepts, with their universal appl
Accounting concepts in interpreting financial stat
e: Correct answer: Every company can follow their own accounting concepts as per their convenience (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is/are the objectives of internal audit?

I. Confirm genuineness of liabilities
II. Analyse various risk factors
III. Physical verification of assets
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which one of the following statements is not true about journal entries?

I. Journal entries can be on single entry basis to be modified as (Either one Debit A/C or one Credit A/C)
II. The total of debits must equal the total of credits in any journal entry
III. Journal entry is the entry recording any transaction in the book called journal
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following are the objectives of accounting?

I. Recording financial transaction
II. Ascertainment of results of recorded transaction
III. Preparation of financial statements
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Accounting Standards are made to ensure transparency, consistency, comparability, adequacy and reliability in:
o: Insurance policy statements, as well as policy rul
Financial statements, as well as financial reporting
Insurance policy statements, as well as IRDA repor
e: Correct answer: Financial statements, as well as financial reporting (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Help PQR Ltd. a reinsurer, distinguish between reinsurance and retrocession.
o: Retrocession is when the reinsurance company has t
Retrocession is when the reinsurance company  is p
Retrocession is when one reinsurance company reinsures another reinsurance company
Retrocession is when one reinsurance company pays
Retrocession is when one reinsurance company accep
e: Correct answer: Retrocession is when one reinsurance company reinsures another reinsurance company (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Bank has credited interest of 1,200 and debited 150 for commission in the pass book. In the BRS starting with pass book balance ________________.
o: Rs. 1350 will be deducted from pass book
Rs. 1350 will be added to pass book balance
Rs. 1200 will be deducted from and Rs. 150 will be added to pass book balance.
Rs. 1200 will be added to and Rs.150 will be deduc
e: Correct answer: Rs. 1200 will be deducted from and Rs. 150 will be added to pass book balance. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Returned goods to supplier and received a cheque for refund. Which entry records this?
o: DR Purchase Account CR Purchase return Account
DR Purchase Account CR Bank Account
DR Bank Account CR Purchase Account
DR Bank Account CR Purchase return Account
DR Purchase return Account CR Bank Account
e: Correct answer: DR Bank Account CR Purchase return Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statement/s is/are true regarding bank reconciliation statements?

I. Prepared by an entity and sent to its customers
II. A part of a double entry system
III. Not a part of a double entry system
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A __________________ should not be recognised but only be disclosed.
e: Correct answer: Contingent liability (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Stock is valued at lower of cost or net realisable value. This is an example of:
e: Correct answer: Prudence Concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A student of commerce is trying to understand the golden rules of accountancy. Tell him which of the following statements are incorrect regarding the same?
o: A transaction is recorded as a 'debit entry' (Dr.)
The process of debiting and crediting accounts is
These golden rules imply the rules of debit and cr
As per the golden rules we need to credit what comes in and debit what goes out for all accounts
e: Correct answer: As per the golden rules we need to credit what comes in and debit what goes out for all accounts (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: After recording the entries in Journal, the entries are posted into _________.
e: Correct answer: Ledger (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Depreciation is provided at 50% of the applicable rates as above on additions made to fixed assets, which are put into use for less than six months and also sold during the year. Analyse the statement and choose the best option.
o: Depreciation is provided at 35% of the applicable

Depreciation is provided at 50% of the applicable rates on additions made to fixed assets, which are put into use for less than six months and but no depreciation is provided on assets sold during the year
e: Correct answer: Depreciation is provided at 50% of the applicable rates on additions made to fixed assets, which are put into use for less than six months and but no depreciation is provided on assets sold during the year (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is an element of the corporate governance?

I. Internal Audit
II. Management
III. External auditor
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following errors would have caused a difference in the trial balance?
o: Not accounting for Rs. 10,000 paid for purchasing
Posting to Motor vehicles account Rs. 500 paid for
Posting payment of Rs. 31,000 for stationery as Rs. 13,000 to the Stationery account
Recording a sale of Rs. 10,000 as Rs. 1,000 in the
A voucher of Rs. 10,000 for purchase has been lost
e: Correct answer: Posting payment of Rs. 31,000 for stationery as Rs. 13,000 to the Stationery account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For an asset owned for more than one year, the depreciation charge for the year,calculated using the reducing-balance basis at the rate of 35%, would be arrived at as follows:-
o: 35% x (cost of the asset - accumulated depreciatio)
35% x (cost of the asset + accumulated depreciatio
35% x (cost of the asset / accumulated depreciatio
e: Correct answer: 35% x (cost of the asset - accumulated depreciatio) (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is not entered on the credit side of the debtors ledger?
e: Correct answer: Return outwards (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC insurance company wants to know a suitable reinsurance arrangement when certain risks are excluded from their obligatory reinsurance cover. Advise.
e: Correct answer: Facultative reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: __________ is an independent appraisal function, established within an organisation to examine and evaluate its activities as a service to the organisation.
e: Correct answer: Internal audit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is/are the purpose of reinsurance arrangement?

I. To provide stability to the company by balancing good years with bad years
II. To spread the risk over large number of insurers
III. To facilitate greater application of principle "Law of Large Numbers
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A summary of ledger balances is prepared, known as ___________.
e: Correct answer: Trial balance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: General insurance companies doing more than one business e.g., fire, marine, etc. need to prepare separate Revenue A/c for each business. Debate.
o: General insurance companies doing more than one bu
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A non-life insurance company is required to  prepare financial statements on which basis as per provisions of Insurance Amendment Act, 2015 and the Companies Act, 2013?
o: Book Value convention and accrual basis
Market cost convention and actual basis
Historic cost convention and actual basis
Historic cost convention and accrual basis
Market cost convention and accrual basis
e: Correct answer: Historic cost convention and accrual basis (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A fire insurance company has some difference between the acquisition cost and the redemption value of Short Term Money Market Instruments such as Commercial Papers and Certificates of Deposit. Suggest the way in which this difference shall be treated in the books.

I. Recognised as accrued income
II. Recognised as revenue
III. Recognised as increase in the value of investment
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with IAS 1 Presentation of financial statements, which financial statements must be presented and reported?
o: i) Balance Sheet, ii) Statement of changes in Equi
i) Income statement, ii) Cash Flow Statement
i) Balance Sheet,  ii) Income statement, iii) Cash Flow Statement, iv) Statement of changes in Equity, v) Notes to Accounts
Statement of changes in Equity and Notes to Accoun
e: Correct answer: i) Balance Sheet,  ii) Income statement, iii) Cash Flow Statement, iv) Statement of changes in Equity, v) Notes to Accounts (from the IC46 question bank).
